# Generating Bindings with bindgen

```
C Headers (include/linux/*.h)
       │
       ▼
rust/bindings/bindings_helper.h
       │
       ▼
kernel::bindings
```

```rust,ignore
// Generated by bindgen inside kernel::bindings:
extern "C" {
    pub fn mutex_lock(lock: *mut mutex);
    pub fn mutex_unlock(lock: *mut mutex);
    pub fn kmalloc(size: usize, flags: gfp_t) -> *mut core::ffi::c_void;
}
```

- Show [`rust/bindings/bindings_helper.h`](https://github.com/Darksonn/linux/blob/rfl-course-edu/rust/bindings/bindings_helper.h).
